# Hurfi
> Global Growth Partner for Chinese Manufacturers

Hurfi helps Chinese manufacturers, suppliers, and B2B companies build a strong digital presence through websites, SEO, digital marketing, and social media management — helping them become more visible, trusted, and scalable globally.

Primary audience: Chinese manufacturers, Chinese suppliers, Chinese exporters, and Chinese B2B companies

## Services
- [Website Development](https://hurfi.com/services/website-development/)
- [SEO](https://hurfi.com/services/seo/)
- [Digital Marketing](https://hurfi.com/services/digital-marketing/)
- [Social Media Management](https://hurfi.com/services/social-media-management/)

## FAQ
### Is the consultation free?
Yes, for a limited time. You get a clear review of your digital presence and the next steps.

### What does Hurfi actually do?
Buyer-ready websites, international SEO, digital campaigns, and social for Chinese manufacturers, suppliers, and exporters.

### Why do strong factories still miss international leads?
Capability does not create visibility. Buyers have to find you, understand the factory, and see a clear way to inquire.

### Do you work with suppliers and exporters?
Yes. The work is built around how global B2B buyers evaluate a Chinese supplier, not a generic local shop.

### How is this different from a general agency?
Hurfi stays on manufacturer positioning, search, and the path from a visit to an inquiry. Not one-off creative.
